messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: metering.alerts.token_drift - EU emitters showing sustained negative delta vs shadow ledger (~15% under expected) over last 30m. Possible customer overage flags. TS: 2026-03-21T09:12:25Z
sarah-oncall: I'm on it. Paging @jorge-billing and @emily-sre. Any known deploys?
jorge-billing: seeing spike in overage_flags for EU customers in last 45m. Shadow tally (shadow_agg) is stable, live tally is dropping. sample req_ids: abc123, def456. :eyes:
emily-sre: checking emitter ingestion. consumer lag visible for eu partition. Running consumer-lag check now.
sarah-oncall: run quick health checks and confirm if this affects billing pipeline or only live alerts.
emily-sre: command output:
```
$ kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-eu:9092 --describe --group meter-consumer
TOPIC          PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
emits-eu       3          1542300         1575300         33000
```
emily-sre: looks like consumer stuck on emitter-ingest-2 pod due to GC churn. Restarting emitter-ingest-2 now.
ops-bot: k8s action: restarting pod/emitter-ingest-2 in eu1 — rollout started.
maya-support: any customer impact? do we need to notify?
jorge-billing: yes, 8 customers already got overage_flags in last 40m. Confirming if those are false positives.
sarah-oncall: temporarily suppress auto overage emails for EU region until we verify. @raj-product can you hold emails for 1h?
raj-product: holding outbound billing emails for EU for 1h. If this becomes longer we'll follow CS-approved template.
emily-sre: pod restarted. Re-checking consumer lag: LAG now 2300 and trending down.
emily-sre: tailing emitter logs prior to restart showed repeated "kafka offset commit timeout" errors and oom-kill warnings.
sarah-oncall: ok prioritize backfill for missing emits. @jorge-billing what's the reconciliation plan?
jorge-billing: triggering recon job: `shadow-reconcile --range "2026-03-21T08:00Z/2026-03-21T09:00Z"` to reconcile missing tokens and retract overage flags. Kicking it off now.
jorge-billing: recon job triggered job_id=job-20260321-0910.
sarah-oncall: escalate if recon >30m. I'll keep the bridge.
emily-sre: monitoring: live vs shadow delta closing to <1% after restart. Good sign, continuing to watch.
ops-bot: recon job job-20260321-0910 progress: 0% -> 10% -> 40% (periodic updates).
maya-support: CS created internal ticket and paused escalation for the 8 flagged customers; proactively reaching out to top 3.
jorge-billing: recon job job-20260321-0910 status=success. Overages re-evaluated: 8 flagged customers cleared, no charges applied.
maya-support: confirmed CS outreach complete; customers acknowledge and no billing applied.
sarah-oncall: quick post-incident notes: likely root cause = emitter consumer lag (GC/oom on emitter-ingest-2) causing delayed commits -> live tally short -> automated overage flags. Mitigations: restarted pod, suppressed emails, ran backfill recon. Next actions: add liveness probe, increase kafka commit timeout, and tweak billing alert thresholds.
raj-product: created follow-up task in tracker, owner @emily-sre, due EOW.
emily-sre: will add liveness probe + increase commit timeout + monitor for GC patterns. Also scheduling a capacity review of eu ingest fleet.
sarah-oncall: closing pager in 15m if metrics stable. Great work. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Pager resolved: metering.alerts.token_drift — severity=P2 — duration=58m
